subjects.title: Mechanical design
subjects.description: Give a robot its shape, strength and ways to move.

subjects.title: Electronics & sensing
subjects.description: Bring power in and turn the physical world into signals.

subjects.title: Programming
subjects.description: Turn signals and ideas into repeatable robot behavior.

subjects.title: Motion & control
subjects.description: Connect commanded movement to what a robot actually does.

topics.title: Structures & materials
topics.subject: mechanical-design
topics.description: Understand how loads, stiffness and material choices shape a robot.
topics.established: Rigid frames hold sensors and motors in repeatable positions.
topics.research: Compliant structures adapt to contact and distribute loads.
topics.question: How do you balance weight, strength, repairability and unpredictable impacts?

topics.title: Mechanisms & drivetrains
topics.subject: mechanical-design
topics.description: Explore gears, belts, joints and the trade between speed and force.
topics.established: Gears and linkages transform motion for wheels, arms and grippers.
topics.research: Soft and underactuated mechanisms use their physical design to simplify control.
topics.question: How can a mechanism remain efficient and reliable when its load changes?

topics.title: CAD & fabrication
topics.subject: mechanical-design
topics.description: Move from an idea to parts that fit together.
topics.established: Parametric models and drawings make assemblies reproducible.
topics.research: Soft robotics explores molds and fabrication processes for compliant parts.
topics.question: How do tolerances and manufacturing choices change the behavior of the finished robot?

topics.title: Circuits & power
topics.subject: electronics-sensing
topics.description: Understand the electrical path from a power source to a working robot.
topics.established: Regulators, motor drivers and protection circuits distribute power to different loads.
topics.research: Embedded robotics keeps pushing toward smaller systems with tighter power budgets.
topics.question: How do you keep measurements and computation stable when motors draw changing current?

topics.title: Microcontrollers & interfaces
topics.subject: electronics-sensing
topics.description: Explore the small computers that read sensors and command hardware.
topics.established: Microcontrollers handle sensor sampling, digital inputs and motor commands.
topics.research: micro-ROS connects constrained devices to larger robot software systems.
topics.question: How can a tiny device meet timing and memory constraints while communicating reliably?

topics.title: Sensors & measurement
topics.subject: electronics-sensing
topics.description: Discover what sensors report, what they miss and how to check their readings.
topics.established: Encoders, light sensors and inertial sensors measure different aspects of a robot and its surroundings.
topics.research: Robotics research combines imperfect measurements to estimate hidden states.
topics.question: How can a robot recognize a bad reading instead of confidently acting on it?

topics.title: Programming fundamentals
topics.subject: programming
topics.description: Build the vocabulary to describe behavior in code.
topics.established: Functions, state and tests turn individual commands into repeatable behavior.
topics.research: Robotics software tools combine simulation and optimization with conventional programs.
topics.question: How do you make behavior understandable when many components run at once?

topics.title: Working with sensor data
topics.subject: programming
topics.description: Make readings useful through arrays, visualization and uncertainty.
topics.established: Calibration, filtering and plotting reveal trends in noisy measurements.
topics.research: State estimation combines models with uncertain measurements.
topics.question: How much should you trust each sensor when measurements disagree?

topics.title: Robot software & communication
topics.subject: programming
topics.description: Connect components with messages, timing and clear responsibilities.
topics.established: Message-based systems separate sensing, computation and action into components.
topics.research: Embedded integration and model-based tools connect hardware constraints to higher-level software.
topics.question: How can a system recover when a message arrives late or one component stops?

topics.title: Actuators & motor control
topics.subject: motion-control
topics.description: Compare ways to turn electrical energy into controlled movement.
topics.established: Motor drivers and servo systems convert control signals into physical motion.
topics.research: Underactuated robotics studies movement with fewer independent controls than degrees of freedom.
topics.question: How do torque, speed, heat and power limits constrain the movement you can achieve?

topics.title: Position & motion models
topics.subject: motion-control
topics.description: Describe where a robot is and how its movement changes that position.
topics.established: Kinematic models relate wheel or joint motion to robot position.
topics.research: Optimization and contact-rich dynamics extend models to more complicated movement.
topics.question: How can a useful model account for slipping wheels and uncertain contact?

topics.title: Feedback & PID
topics.subject: motion-control
topics.description: Use the gap between a target and a measurement to correct behavior.
topics.established: Feedback regulates motor speed, position and line-following behavior.
topics.research: Nonlinear and optimization-based control tackle dynamics beyond simple fixed-gain loops.
topics.question: How can a controller stay stable across delays, disturbances and changing loads?

mechanics.title: Engineering mechanics
mechanics.description: Investigate loads, stress and deformation before choosing a structure.

arduino.title: Arduino built-in examples
arduino.description: Try small experiments with digital signals, analog readings and timing.

multimeter.title: How to use a multimeter
multimeter.description: Learn what measurements can tell you when a circuit behaves unexpectedly.

i2c.title: I²C communication
i2c.description: Understand how a controller exchanges messages with peripheral devices.

sensors.title: Introduction to robotics
sensors.description: Explore sensing, uncertainty and mobile robots through worked computational examples.

python.title: The Python tutorial
python.description: Use functions, collections and modules to organize small programs.

beginner.title: Python for beginners
beginner.description: Find installation help and entry points for your first programming experience.

numpy.title: NumPy: the absolute basics for beginners
numpy.description: Work with arrays when readings become too numerous to inspect one at a time.

ros.title: ROS 2 Jazzy tutorials
ros.description: Explore nodes, messages and services as building blocks for robot software.

git.title: Pro Git
git.description: Keep a recoverable history of experiments and understand what changed.

motors.title: All about stepper motors
motors.description: Compare stepper arrangements, drivers and the limits of open-loop positioning.

modern.title: Modern Robotics video supplements
modern.description: Connect robot geometry, motion and control to mathematical models.

feedback.title: Introduction to PID
feedback.description: Understand feedback through error, gains and practical controller behavior.

pololu.description: Inspect a complete small robot with sensors, encoders and example programs.

servo.title: Servo motor basics with Arduino
servo.description: Connect a hobby servo and observe commanded position changes.

soft.title: Soft Robotics Toolkit
soft.description: Explore compliant structures and fabrication approaches beyond rigid mechanisms.

drake.title: Drake model-based design and verification
drake.description: Explore simulation, optimization and control of complex robot systems.

underactuated.title: Underactuated robotics
underactuated.description: Explore nonlinear dynamics and control when a system cannot command every motion directly.

micro.title: micro-ROS
micro.description: Investigate how microcontrollers can participate in a ROS 2 system.

algebra.title: Algebra and Trigonometry 2e
algebra.description: Revisit equations, functions and angles when a robotics resource uses unfamiliar math.

physics.title: College Physics 2e
physics.description: Find background on forces, energy and electricity alongside worked examples.

linear.title: Linear algebra
linear.description: Build a foundation in vectors and matrices for motion models and estimation.
